newsitem.title: UK: Deloitte Touche merges with Danish City Revision.
newsitem.headline: Deloitte Touche merges with Danish City Revision.

text.p: International accounting firm Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu (DTTI) said on Thursday its Danish practice would merge with Danish audit firm City Revision.

Deloitte Touche said in a statement the merger would be completed by January 1 and would "strengthen DTTI's position as a leading provider of auditing and consulting services in the Danish marketplace".

It said the merged group would be known as Deloitte & Touche and would have 1,350 employees in 27 cities throughout Denmark, including Greenland, with fee income of approximately 750 million Danish crowns.
Copenhagen-based audit firm City Revision has a total of 80 employees, including 11 partners.
